useCases.title: What can you snap?

why.p1: Most schedules never arrive as a neat file. They arrive as a photo in WhatsApp or Messenger — a class routine pinned on a notice board, a duty roster screenshot, a wedding invitation, a prescription. Typing them into a calendar by hand is slow, and one missed line means a missed class, a missed shift, or a missed dose. A photo to calendar tool fixes exactly that: snap it, check it, and your calendar does the remembering.
why.p2: RoutineSnap was built for students and workers in Bangladesh, Japan and India, where routines really do travel as photos. It reads Bangla, English and Japanese text, understands weekly class routines, night shifts that cross midnight, and exam dates — and turns them into a standard image to ICS file or Google Calendar events, with reminders attached.
why.p3: And it does all of this without keeping your photos. Images are processed in memory and discarded, so a class routine to calendar or duty roster to calendar conversion leaves no copy behind. No account, no tracking, no storage — just your schedule, on your calendar, on time.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: RoutineSnap is built to forget. This policy explains, in plain language, what happens to your photos and what we never store.

sections.heading: What we process
sections.body: When you upload a photo, it is sent securely to our server, read by the vision AI, and turned into calendar events. The image and the extracted events are processed in memory and discarded as soon as your result is returned. They are never saved to disk or to a database.

sections.heading: What we store
sections.body: We run no database in v1 and store no photos, no extracted schedules, and no account data on the server. The only thing that can be stored is your optional local history, which lives in your own browser (IndexedDB) and never leaves your device.

sections.heading: Cookies and trackers
sections.body: RoutineSnap is cookie-free by default and uses no third-party trackers. Optional privacy-friendly analytics (Plausible) can be enabled by the site operator; it sets no cookies and does not track you across sites.

sections.heading: What we log
sections.body: We do not log image data or extracted schedule content. Server logs keep only the minimum needed to run the service and to enforce the daily scan limit (5 scans per day per IP address).

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can use RoutineSnap without signing up and without saving anything. If you saved local history, you can delete one scan or all of it from the History page, or clear your browser data.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: If you have a privacy question, use the contact links on the About page.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Plain-language terms for using RoutineSnap. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the service.

sections.heading: The service
sections.body: RoutineSnap turns photos of schedules into calendar events with reminders. It is provided free of charge, “as is”, without any warranty. We may change or stop the service at any time.

sections.heading: Your responsibility
sections.body: Always review the extracted events before adding them to your calendar. The AI can misread a photo, especially a blurry or handwritten one. You are responsible for the events you save.

sections.heading: Medicine schedules
sections.body: Medicine reminders are a convenience helper, not medical advice. Always follow your doctor's prescription. Never change a dose or stop a medicine because of what this app shows.

sections.heading: Fair use
sections.body: The free tier allows 5 scans per day per IP address. Do not abuse the service, try to break it, or use it to process other people's private photos without their permission.

sections.heading: Your content
sections.body: Photos you upload are processed in memory and discarded. You keep all rights to your photos and schedules. We claim no ownership over them.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for missed classes, shifts, exams or doses, or for any loss caused by an incorrect extraction. Please double-check important dates.

about.title: About RoutineSnap
about.subtitle: A small, privacy-first tool that turns a photo of a schedule into calendar events with reminders.
about.missionBody: Routines arrive as photos — a class routine on a notice board, a duty roster in a WhatsApp group, an exam schedule shared as a screenshot. Typing them into a calendar by hand is slow, and forgetting one means a missed class, a missed shift, or a missed dose. RoutineSnap exists so a photo becomes reminders in seconds, without signing up and without your photo ever being stored.
